# errorism.dev

> > A curated collection exploring internet culture, memes, and Microsoft technology ecosystems.

This site bridges viral internet phenomena documented on Know Your Meme with Microsoft's enterprise products and corporate infrastructure. It serves as a reference for understanding both contemporary meme culture (particularly TikTok trends) and Microsoft's technology stack including Copilot AI, Microsoft 365, and campus operations.

## Key Topics

- Know Your Meme
- TikTok trends
- Microsoft 365
- Copilot AI
- Viral memes
- Internet culture
- Windows 11
- Excel
- Microsoft campus
- Catchphrase memes
- Redmond, Washington
- Breaking Bad memes
- Surface devices
- Xbox gaming

## Microsoft Products & Services

- [Microsoft – AI, Cloud, Productivity, Computing, Gaming & Apps](https://microsoft.com/en-us): Microsoft homepage showcasing products: Windows 11, Copilot, Xbox, Surface
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot | Create, Share and Collaborate with Office and AI](https://office.com): Microsoft 365 Copilot hub for Word, Excel, PowerPoint collaboration

## Meme Reference Database

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme: Walter White/Jesse Pinkman generational gap
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring heartbreaking cat/kitten artwork from DeviantArt
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending as TikTok lip-dub audio

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Explainer on Nasra Ahmed viral ICE detention speech meme from Minneapolis
- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of 22 relatable memes about depression, anxiety & mental health
